backtest.disclaimer: DEM+ is scored against next season's published fielding rate. Positional credit and innings are context: DEM+ is glove per inning, not positional value.

frame.basis: FanGraphs' served fielding runs, read verbatim from MLB StatsAPI sabermetrics
frame.components: Statcast range and arm (retroactive to 2016), catcher blocking and throwing, and catcher framing
frame.framing_derivation: rar minus batting, baseRunning, fielding, positional, wLeague and replacement; matches FanGraphs CFraming exactly on the seasons checked
frame.ewar_note: Its fielding is Baseball-Reference's (fielding_blend_w 0.0), a different frame from Fld and DEM+.
frame.claim: parity with the fWAR fielding frame, framing included; DEM+ is a steadier read of that published series, not a better measure of it
frame.def_basis: Def = FanGraphs fielding and framing + our positional ladder (Position Fit, Baseball-Reference scale); FanGraphs' own positional rides beside it as pos_runs_fg

published_fielding.note: Fielding and framing runs, and pos_runs_fg, are FanGraphs' PUBLISHED values, read verbatim from MLB's bulk season-total feed and joined by MLBAM id. The site computes DEM+ and the positional term inside Def (pos_runs, our ladder).

innings.note: Defensive innings by position from MLB's season fielding feed, converted from baseball thirds at ingest.

scale.rate_basis: runs per 1,000 defensive innings (C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, LF, CF, RF)
scale.k_source: frozen from the pre-registered fit window, predictor seasons 2016 to 2018 (docs/dem-plus-2026-09-11/DEM_PLUS_GATE.md); LF keeps the positional_fit constant
scale.note: dem_plus_raw = 100 + 10 * (rate_1000_shrunk - pool_mean_rate) / pool_sd_rate: 10 points = 1 SD of the pool's SHRUNK rates (the WAR/PA+ ruler, not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio ruler).

positional.units: runs per 650 PA, pro-rated by innings at each fielding position
positional.note: pos_runs = sum over C to RF of ladder rung x innings at the position / inn_per_650pa. The ladder is inverted from Baseball-Reference's positional runs, so Def is FanGraphs fielding and framing plus a Baseball-Reference-scale positional term, not FanGraphs Def. pos_runs_fg is FanGraphs' own positional, for comparison; it is in no sum.

below_floor.rule: every fielder with window innings; a fielder under 400 innings is published as provisional, with his innings on the row

multiyear.note: 3-year DEM+ is the Last 3 window's index read from mlbstats_window_l3.json (built 2026-10-08), the same value the Last 3 view prints. The percentile is inside the window's pool; no value ruler is carried onto it. Fielders the window does not publish have no value. The window publishes every fielder with window innings; a fielder under 400 innings is published as provisional, with his innings on the row.

team_rollup_framing.note: Team DEM+ and the club run totals include catchers and their framing (team_frm_runs), and each alignment's catcher slot carries his framing.

savant_catcher.source: Baseball Savant catcher blocking and catcher throwing leaderboards

c_blk_pitches.counts: pitches received that the blocking model scores

c_blk_runs.counts: runs saved by blocking, Savant's own run value

c_blk_aa.counts: blocks above average on those pitches

c_cs_runs.counts: runs saved on those attempts, Savant's own run value

c_cs_aa.counts: caught stealing above the expected count

c_pop.counts: average pop time to second base, seconds

c_arm.counts: average arm strength on throws, mph

savant_catcher.scope: rows whose primary position is C
savant_catcher.use: display only; DEM+, eWAR, Position Fit and the team rollups do not read these columns

hem_plus_join.note: HEM+ joined from hitter_leaderboards.json for the glove-versus-bat chart

ewar_join.basis: bat + pit, summed unrounded and rounded once

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar.json rebuilds its live season nightly; completed seasons are frozen byte for byte and re-priced only by a hand build with the runbook cascade.

team_basis.label: fielding 2026
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

roster_filter.scope: the constructed alignment ONLY. Team DEM+ and the run totals stay on the full season pool.
roster_filter.on_failure: a failed roster fetch filters nothing
